name: portable-agent-skills
description: Portable skills for Chat, Work, and Codex: Humanizer, Natural Japanese, yomiyasu, optional i-have-adhd formatting, and explicit Hallmark UI audits.

interface.shortDescription: Portable skills for Chat, Work, and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Three writing skills with language- and task-specific selection, optional i-have-adhd formatting, and explicit read-only Hallmark UI audits.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose one bundled writing skill for the target text and task. Honor an explicit skill name; otherwise use yomiyasu for existing Japanese prose, natural-japanese for new Japanese documents or diagnosis, and humanizer for non-Japanese prose. Do not automatically chain skills. Invoke i-have-adhd and Hallmark only when explicitly requested.
